source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: A traffic stop may result in a warning or traffic ticket which may include a fine or arrest and the officer will typically explain the action taken.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported claim that the driver is asked to explain what happened.

corrections.corrected_statement: An employee of the United States government operating a motor vehicle owned by or leased to the United States government or operated on official business need not obtain a Georgia license unless the United States government requires a state license.
corrections.note: Corrected conjunctive wording to disjunctive or as printed on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: A person on active duty in the armed forces of the United States with a valid license issued in a foreign country by the armed forces of the United States may use that license for not more than forty five days after returning to the United States.
corrections.note: Corrected issuer from foreign armed forces to United States armed forces.

corrections.corrected_statement: If changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible prohibited by law or unsafe reduce speed to at least ten miles per hour below the posted speed limit or twenty five miles per hour whichever is greater and keep at least three feet from the bicycle at all times.
corrections.note: Added the required speed reduction that the original omitted.

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers must not hold or support a phone for any reason and may use a phone only with headphones, a wireless device, a phone holder or a mounted device.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported hearing impairment prohibition not on provided pages.

corrections.corrected_statement: If a lane change away from a postal service vehicle or vehicle with active sanitation workers displaying flashing lights would be impossible or prohibited by law or unsafe, reduce speed to a reasonable and proper speed for the existing road and traffic conditions that is at least ten miles per hour less than the posted speed limit or twenty five miles per hour whichever is more and be prepared to stop.
corrections.note: Added missing specific speed reduction requirement.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you start to skid ease your foot off the accelerator, turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid, and after you regain control lightly apply the brakes and steer in a safe direction.
corrections.note: Added the required steering direction and corrected the vague conditions language.

corrections.corrected_statement: Because bicyclists may be on any road at any time, drivers must always be alert for bicycle traffic.
corrections.note: Removed larger vehicle assumption which the pages state for motorcycles not bicycles.

corrections.corrected_statement: If changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible, prohibited by law, or unsafe, slow to at least ten miles per hour below the posted speed limit or twenty five miles per hour whichever is greater and leave at least three feet between the vehicle and the bicycle at all times.
corrections.note: Added the required speed reduction that the original statement omitted.

corrections.corrected_statement: When towing a trailer, take your time and if you lose control stay calm.
corrections.note: Removed claim that the checklist is incomplete which no page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver under twenty one faces suspension for a conviction for any four point violation and a driver under eighteen faces suspension for accumulating four points within twelve months.
corrections.note: Changed at least four points to any four point violation for drivers under twenty one.
